criteria.description: The additive v1 ingestion envelope returns normalized content, exact source, derivatives, and provenance without changing Result.
criteria.evidence: test/contract/ingestion_contract_test.go and test/acceptance/retained_ingestion_test.go pass through exported Engine.Ingest and VerifyEnvelope.

criteria.description: The envelope owns exact source bytes, length, media facts, and SHA-256 identity.
criteria.evidence: retained_ingestion_test.go persists, discards, reloads, recomputes, and reverifies the source from fresh disk reads.

criteria.description: Normalized Markdown is a canonical UTF-8 primary artifact with role, media type, length, and digest.
criteria.evidence: ingestion contract and retained journey tests compare primary bytes and identities after independent reload.

criteria.description: Derived artifacts carry owned bytes, stable metadata, relationships, lengths, and identities.
criteria.evidence: converters/pdf detailed and artifact-limit tests plus retained PDF journey verify every derivative and relationship.

criteria.description: Provenance is deterministic and identifies contract, converter, effective policy, fact origins, and output identities.
criteria.evidence: ingestion model/engine tests and the 100-run reproducibility matrix compare canonical provenance byte-for-byte.

criteria.description: Artifact order and local references resolve deterministically after engine-owned final-ID assignment.
criteria.evidence: PDF mixed-image, identical-occurrence, strict token-boundary, and 100-run tests pass through public Ingest.

criteria.description: One policy uniformly bounds every local and remote source form before dispatch.
criteria.evidence: source acquisition and aggregate security boundary matrices pass at limit and fail at limit plus one with zero dispatch.

criteria.description: ZIP, EPUB, OOXML, and XLSX share bounded entry, byte, ratio, and depth accounting.
criteria.evidence: container_security_test.go suites for ZIP, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX pass hostile at-limit/over-limit cases.

criteria.description: Remote access is disabled by default and enabled access re-admits every redirect and pins approved destinations.
criteria.evidence: internal/ingestion remote tests and source tests cover zero-call disabled authority, IANA address denial, redirects, DNS pinning, and body limits.

criteria.description: OCR, inference, model, component, and download effects remain explicit and inactive by default.
criteria.evidence: security_boundaries_test.go reports remote/model/component/download counters exactly zero across public matrices.

criteria.description: Public failures retain typed unsupported, malformed, limit, policy, integrity, cancellation, and converter categories.
criteria.evidence: ingestion verifier, source, container, and contract suites use errors.Is/typed outcomes without parsing backend text.

criteria.description: Legacy Result, Converter, and every conversion entry point remain source compatible.
criteria.evidence: test/contract/legacy_compatibility_test.go compiles an external consumer using positional Result, equality/map keys, custom Converter, and all Convert entry points.

criteria.description: The default CLI retains Markdown stdout and existing flags without implicit binary or envelope output.
criteria.evidence: cmd/inkbite CLI snapshot and compatibility tests pass; main.go remains frozen.

criteria.description: Public verification recomputes identities and rejects malformed, missing, duplicate, substituted, or cross-envelope data without effects.
criteria.evidence: ingestion_verify_test.go and retained mutation matrices exercise pure VerifyEnvelope with byte mutations and structural substitutions.

criteria.description: Primary and derivative bytes/counts are policy-bounded before any successful envelope returns.
criteria.evidence: ingestion policy, engine, PDF artifact-limit, and aggregate at-limit/plus-one tests pass.

criteria.description: Unsupported members and optional extraction failures are visible as stable warnings or typed failures.
criteria.evidence: ZIP/EPUB detailed warnings and PPTX malformed-notes public Ingest regression pass while legacy Markdown stays stable.

criteria.description: A configured engine supports concurrent conversions without cross-request data, policy, artifact, or provenance leakage.
criteria.evidence: engine 100-run concurrency tests and the full race suite pass with owned byte and request-budget isolation.

criteria.description: Representative text, PDF, office, and nested-archive conversions are byte-reproducible across 100 runs.
criteria.evidence: test/acceptance/reproducibility_test.go passes its canonical 100-run matrix.

criteria.description: Every byte-bearing identity is recomputed and a one-byte mutation is rejected.
criteria.evidence: public verifier and retained security mutation matrices cover source, primary, and every derivative.

criteria.description: Every source kind passes at 32 MiB and fails at 32 MiB plus one before dispatch.
criteria.evidence: source acquisition and aggregate boundary tables cover bytes, reader, seeker, path, file URI, data URI, and remote response.

criteria.description: Container defaults enforce 256 entries, 8 MiB per entry, 32 MiB expanded, depth four, and the ratio ceiling.
criteria.evidence: shared container-ledger boundary suites pass across ZIP, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX.

criteria.description: Disabled remote authority makes zero calls and enabled policy denies all enumerated non-global destinations and redirect bypasses.
criteria.evidence: WP03 IANA 2025-10-09 table, redirect, DNS admission, pinned-dial, and zero-authority tests pass.

criteria.description: Fallback and error paths perform no hidden inference, component, model, or download effects.
criteria.evidence: WP09 counting sentinels remain exactly zero in normal and hostile public journeys.

criteria.description: Cancellation is typed, returns no envelope, joins owned cooperative work promptly, and never detaches arbitrary non-cooperative reads.
criteria.evidence: WP03 synchronized ten-case cancellation matrix passes under binding ruling 57bc26c and amendment 9929836.

criteria.description: All pre-mission API, converter, CLI, and format contracts remain compatible.
criteria.evidence: external compatibility fixtures, apidiff, CLI snapshots, and full format tests pass.

criteria.description: The full race suite and concurrent stress matrix report no races, aliasing, or policy leakage.
criteria.evidence: go test -race ./... and acceptance race count=3 passed once on the final frozen review tree.

criteria.description: Fixed-base changed production coverage exceeds 80.0% unrounded with causal mutation evidence.
criteria.evidence: make quality reports 1815/2053 = 88.407209%; coverage self-mutation changes 1/5 red to 5/5 green.

criteria.description: Errors and public metadata redact credentials, data payloads, source bytes, grants, and backend detail.
criteria.evidence: sanitization, remote, container, worker-warning, and aggregate secret-sentinel tests pass.

criteria.description: Binary fixtures and artifact results remain portable across Linux, macOS, and Windows checkouts.
criteria.evidence: cross-platform CI/compile checks and fresh core.autocrlf=true fixture check preserve 587 bytes and SHA-256 0c839d2bbb8c86f4a4ceb48706070efaed8c9880d15dd7a4b815b6de2b63a23b.

criteria.description: Default primary and derivative result ceilings pass at limit and fail at limit plus one.
criteria.evidence: policy, engine, PDF, and aggregate boundary suites cover primary 32 MiB, 256 artifacts, 8 MiB each, and 32 MiB aggregate.

criteria.description: Repository-authored source remains MIT; adopted components are recorded; official artifacts are source-only and cannot publish the unqualified GPL-linked binary.
criteria.evidence: WP09 source-package/publication matrix inspects exact 355-file tracked-source manifests, forbids executables/vendor/dependency source, and pins CI/tag upload paths plus the GPL warning.
criteria.notes: Arbiter ruling cb482ca; source package reproducibility verified.

criteria.description: Inkbite returns owned values but does not own Nano Kitty persistence or cleanup policy.
criteria.evidence: Retained journey uses a host-owned temporary store; no production persistent/session store was introduced.

criteria.description: Conversion performs no automatic network expansion or component/model download.
criteria.evidence: Remote is off by default and WP09 hidden-effect counters remain zero.

criteria.description: Detailed and legacy conversion use one engine/registry/acquisition/sealing pipeline.
criteria.evidence: WP04 shared runIngestionPipeline is the single authority; all legacy entry points project from it.

criteria.description: Identity, artifact, and policy contracts preserve future streaming compatibility.
criteria.evidence: Public values bind exact bytes/digests and policy without exposing storage locations or requiring current buffer internals.

criteria.description: Content identity is canonical lowercase SHA-256 over exact bytes only.
criteria.evidence: Verifier recomputation and mutation tests cover every source/primary/derivative identity.

criteria.description: Returned byte slices do not alias caller buffers, scratch storage, or other artifacts.
criteria.evidence: WP01 accessible-capacity overlap checks, WP02 clipped read seals, WP04 envelope seals, and concurrent alias stress pass.

criteria.description: The mission adds no new format, OCR, captioning, transcription, or layout-fidelity promise.
criteria.evidence: Scope changes only the ingestion contract, trust boundaries, existing PDF derivatives, compatibility docs, and release qualification.

criteria.description: A host can ingest, verify, persist, discard runtime state, reload exact text/PDF values, and reverify.
criteria.evidence: test/acceptance/retained_ingestion_test.go passes from fresh disk reads after all original runtime values are dropped.

criteria.description: Representative text, PDF, office, and nested archive results are canonical across 100 conversions.
criteria.evidence: test/acceptance/reproducibility_test.go 100-run matrix passes.

criteria.description: All source, output, artifact, and container policy boundaries pass at limit and fail above it without partial success.
criteria.evidence: WP02-WP07 boundary tables and WP09 aggregate matrix pass.
criteria.notes: No disallowed downstream work on over-limit cases.

criteria.description: Remote policy proves zero disabled calls and denies all enumerated address/redirect bypasses.
criteria.evidence: WP03 remote authority and IANA registry matrix pass.

criteria.description: Mutation, omission, duplicate, invalid reference, and cross-envelope substitution all fail verification.
criteria.evidence: ingestion verifier and WP09 security mutation matrices pass.

criteria.description: Existing API, custom converter, CLI, and format suites remain green without adopting the new contract.
criteria.evidence: External legacy fixture, CLI snapshots, all converter tests, full normal suite, and apidiff pass.

criteria.description: Final source-only release qualification has no regression, race, reachable vulnerability, licensing gap, portability drift, or quality failure.
criteria.evidence: WP09 cycle-3 reviewer ran all nine mandatory commands once; coverage 1815/2053=88.407209%, zero reachable vulnerabilities, exact source-only publication surfaces, all gates green.

criteria.description: Public contract and civic adoption documentation are sufficient for host retention and release responsibility without reading internals.
criteria.evidence: README, public API/schema/quickstart contracts, ADOPTED_COMPONENTS, and CHANGELOG align with shipped behavior and source-only release boundary.
